fee_notes: Current initial franchise fee is $50,000 (uniform, non-refundable). Historically, the fee was $25,000 until June 30, 2022, then $50,000 after that date. Some prior franchise agreement holders could purchase additional franchises at a discounted fee of $15,000. Under an area development agreement, the initial franchise fee per unit is also $50,000, with an up-front area development fee equal to $50,000 multiplied by the number of units to be developed (credited toward each unit's franchise fee). A partial refund of the area development fee may apply if the franchisor terminates the area development agreement early under specific conditions.
raw_excerpt: On the signing of the franchise agreement, all franchisees pay an initial franchise fee of $50,000. This initial franchise fee is non-refundable. In the 2022 fiscal year, the initial franchise fee was $25,000 until June 30, 2022 and was $50,000 after June 30, 2022 and was uniform for all franchisees during these time periods, except for franchisees that signed a prior version of our franchise agreement that allowed additional franchises to be purchased at a discounted fee of $15,000.
